cond_0001.intro: Participate in all aspects of the real estate investment/development process including analysis of commercial office, residential, hotel, resort, retail, and mixed-use developments and acquisitions as well as corporate capital market activities, which could include participation in workout, receivership and asset management assignments. Responsibilities include a combination of specific project related work and entity level corporate finance assignments.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Financial Analysis
Perform complete financial analysis of prospective investment and development properties, as well as potential entity-level and platform investment opportunities, including preparation of financial cash flow models, sensitivity analyses and venture investment return analyses. In addition, assist properties in asset management, development, operations and sales and marketing work as necessary.
Investment Documentation
Assist in the preparation of investment collateral material, including investment summaries, private placement memoranda, business plans and presentations.
Due Diligence
Assist with completion of all necessary aspects of the due diligence process for any investment opportunities pursued by the development, acquisition or capital markets groups.
Market Research
Assist in researching and documenting local, regional and national real estate market data relevant to specific investment opportunities.
Sourcing and Capital Raising
Assist with all aspects of the deal sourcing and capital raising process, including participating on broker calls, capital calls, and going-upstream to find investment opportunities.
Development Process
Monitor and report on development process. Document project meetings, task follow-up, status reports and track to completion for overall project support. Assist with preparation and review of monthly reporting. Participate with coordination of consultants during development processes.
Special Projects
Work with project team to research and analyze potential development, redevelopment and/or new business opportunities, and assist in preparation of materials for capital raising initiatives.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Economics, accounting, real estate, and/or finance coursework at a top 4-year institution.
Highest level of personal integrity and ethical standards.
Excellent communication skills – written, oral and interpersonal.
Superior quantitative and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Argus, as well as Word and PowerPoint.
Comprehension of real estate fundamentals.
Preferred Requirements
0 – 2 Years of previous work or internship experience at an investment sales or capital markets brokerage firm, investment bank, development firm, or investment firm.
Strong personal initiative and desire to succeed in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment.
Ability to work with a diverse group of people in a collegial, team framework.
Ability to prioritize duties, process multiple projects, work collaboratively, and meet deadlines.
Grasp of finance and economic principles and market dynamics.

cond_0103.intro: Participate in all aspects of the real estate investment/development process including analysis of commercial office, residential, hotel, resort, retail, and mixed-use developments and acquisitions as well as corporate capital market activities, which could include participation in workout, receivership and asset management assignments. Responsibilities include a combination of specific project related work and entity level corporate finance assignments. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of real estate finance and investment analysis.
cond_0103.responsibilities:
Financial Analysis
Perform complete financial analysis of prospective investment and development properties, as well as potential entity-level and platform investment opportunities, including preparation of financial cash flow models, sensitivity analyses and venture investment return analyses. In addition, assist properties in asset management, development, operations and sales and marketing work as necessary.
Investment Documentation
Assist in the preparation of investment collateral material, including investment summaries, private placement memoranda, business plans and presentations.
Due Diligence
Assist with completion of all necessary aspects of the due diligence process for any investment opportunities pursued by the development, acquisition or capital markets groups.
Market Research
Assist in researching and documenting local, regional and national real estate market data relevant to specific investment opportunities.
Sourcing and Capital Raising
Assist with all aspects of the deal sourcing and capital raising process, including participating on broker calls, capital calls, and going-upstream to find investment opportunities.
Development Process
Monitor and report on development process. Document project meetings, task follow-up, status reports and track to completion for overall project support. Assist with preparation and review of monthly reporting. Participate with coordination of consultants during development processes.
Special Projects
Work with project team to research and analyze potential development, redevelopment and/or new business opportunities, and assist in preparation of materials for capital raising initiatives.
cond_0103.requirements:
Economics, accounting, real estate, and/or finance coursework at a top 4-year institution required.

Highest level of personal integrity and ethical standards.
Strong personal initiative and desire to succeed in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment.

Excellent communication skills – written, oral and interpersonal.
Superior quantitative and analytical skills.
Ability to prioritize duties, process multiple projects, work collaboratively, and meet deadlines.

cond_0223.responsibilities:
Financial Analysis
Perform complete financial analysis of prospective investment and development properties, as well as potential entity-level and platform investment opportunities. This includes preparing financial cash flow models, sensitivity analyses, and venture investment return analyses. Support properties in asset management, development, operations, and sales and marketing work as needed.
Investment Documentation
Contribute to the preparation of investment collateral materials, including investment summaries, private placement memoranda, business plans, and presentations.
Due Diligence
Support completion of all necessary due diligence for investment opportunities pursued by the development, acquisition, or capital markets groups.
Market Research
Research and document local, regional, and national real estate market data relevant to specific investment opportunities.
Sourcing and Capital Raising
Support deal sourcing and capital raising activities, including participating on broker calls, capital calls, and upstream outreach to identify investment opportunities.
Development Process
Monitor and report on the development process. Document project meetings, task follow-up, and status reports, and track items through to completion. Assist with preparation and review of monthly reporting. Coordinate with consultants on development process tasks.
Special Projects
Research and analyze potential development, redevelopment, and new business opportunities in coordination with the project team. Assist with preparation of materials for capital raising initiatives.
cond_0223.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Economics, accounting, real estate, and/or finance coursework at a top 4-year institution
Highest level of personal integrity and ethical standards
Strong quantitative and analytical skills
Solid grasp of real estate fundamentals and finance and economic principles
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Argus, as well as Word and PowerPoint
Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines
Preferred Requirements
0–2 Years of work or internship experience at an investment sales or capital markets brokerage firm, investment bank, development firm, or investment firm
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Ability to work within a team structure across a diverse group of people
Strong personal initiative and drive to succeed in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment

This includes analysis of commercial office, residential, hotel, resort, retail, and mixed-use developments and acquisitions, as well as corporate capital market activities. The role may also involve participation in workout, receivership, and asset management assignments. Work spans both specific project-related tasks and entity-level corporate finance assignments.
cond_0315.responsibilities:
Financial Analysis
Work with the team to perform complete financial analysis of prospective investment and development properties, as well as potential entity-level and platform investment opportunities. This includes helping prepare financial cash flow models, sensitivity analyses, and venture investment return analyses. Also support properties in asset management, development, operations, and sales and marketing work as needed.
Investment Documentation
Help prepare investment collateral materials, including investment summaries, private placement memoranda, business plans, and presentations.
Due Diligence
Coordinate with the development, acquisition, and capital markets groups to help complete all necessary aspects of the due diligence process for investment opportunities pursued.
Market Research
Work alongside team members to research and document local, regional, and national real estate market data relevant to specific investment opportunities.
Sourcing and Capital Raising
Support all aspects of the deal sourcing and capital raising process, including participating on broker calls, capital calls, and going upstream to find investment opportunities.
Development Process
Help monitor and report on the development process. Document project meetings, task follow-up, and status reports, and track progress to completion in support of the overall project. Assist with preparation and review of monthly reporting. Coordinate with consultants during development processes.
Special Projects
Work with the project team to research and analyze potential development, redevelopment, and/or new business opportunities, and help prepare materials for capital raising initiatives.
cond_0315.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Economics, accounting, real estate, and/or finance coursework at a top 4-year institution
0–2 Years of previous work or internship experience at an investment sales or capital markets brokerage firm, investment bank, development firm, or investment firm
Highest level of personal integrity and ethical standards
Strong personal initiative and desire to succeed in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment
Excellent communication skills – written, oral, and interpersonal
Superior quantitative and analytical skills
Comprehension of real estate fundamentals
Grasp of finance and economic principles and market dynamics
Preferred Requirements
Ability to work with a diverse group of people in a collegial, team framework
Ability to prioritize duties, process multiple projects, work collaboratively, and meet deadlines
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Argus, as well as Word and PowerPoint
